### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. Dyggve-Melchior-Clausen disease  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.733)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:21317)

**Proposed mechanism:** DYM (HGNC:21317) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal protein degradation (GO:0000422); Lysosomal protein degradation (GO:0000422) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal dysplasia (HP:0004325); Lysosomal protein degradation (GO:0000422) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal facial shape (HP:0001999). Loss-of-function mutations in DYM disrupt lysosomal protein degradation, leading to a shared pathway dysfunction that manifests as skeletal dysplasia and abnormal facial shape in both diseases.

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in DYM with a gain-of-function mechanism in either disease, or the demonstration that the causal variants for each disease affect entirely distinct cellular processes not related to lysosomal protein degradation. _(variant: rs743419227)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism of lysosomal protein degradation disruption in DYM-related disorders could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting this pathway for both disease A and Dyggve-Melchior-Clausen disease.
